split: canonical-hash-v1: modulo 5 = 0 held out; training always excludes holdout
notes: Distances are normalized Wasserstein-1; lower is better. CI is paired bootstrap conditional on training split. Aggregate weights are heuristic. Historical daily reruns retain their frequency. When comparing v2 to v3, v2 uses original training history and v3 expanded training history. V3 intentionally underweights singleton boards; nonSingletonDistance excludes only the three explicit singleton metrics, retaining correlated features. All generated outputs checked for connectivity and unique solution.
